posts.title: Nerves IoT framework, apparently popular with agents
posts.description: I’ve been active in the Nerves community ever since 2019 when I made it control a small eInk display. It was and is a welcoming group of Elixir nerds and BEAM huggers that do fun stuff with hardware. This is also why I insist on gathering them at Goatmire Elixir. Some do it professionally, some for fun. What makes it nice for developers also seems to make it nice for agents.
